question: centre with the largest drop in attendance percentage between 2023 and 2024 (average of monthly rates, drop in percentage points, positive)
gold_sql: WITH combined AS (SELECT "Centre" AS centre, 2023 AS year, "Avg Daily Present" / "Enrolled Kids" * 100.0 AS rate FROM attendance_2023 UNION ALL SELECT centre_name AS centre, 2024 AS year, average_attendance / enrolment * 100.0 AS rate FROM attendance_2024) , by_year AS (SELECT centre, AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN rate END) AS avg_2023, AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN rate END) AS avg_2024 FROM combined GROUP BY centre) SELECT centre, avg_2023 - avg_2024 AS drop_pp FROM by_year ORDER BY drop_pp DESC, centre LIMIT 1

CURRENT QUESTION:
centre with the largest drop in attendance percentage between 2023 and 2024 (average of monthly rates, drop in percentage points, positive)
attempts.response:
```sql
WITH 
-- Calculate monthly attendance percentage for 2023
att_2023 AS (
    SELECT 
        "Centre",
        "Month",
        ("Avg Daily Present" * 100.0) / NULLIF("Enrolled Kids", 0) AS monthly_rate
    FROM "attendance_2023"
),
-- Calculate monthly attendance percentage for 2024
att_2024 AS (
    SELECT 
        "centre_name" AS "Centre",
        "month" AS "Month",
        ("average_attendance" * 100.0) / NULLIF("enrolment", 0) AS monthly_rate
    FROM "attendance_2024"
),
-- Calculate average monthly rate per centre for 2023
avg_2023 AS (
    SELECT 
        "Centre",
        AVG(monthly_rate) AS avg_rate_2023
    FROM att_2023
    GROUP BY "Centre"
),
-- Calculate average monthly rate per centre for 2024
avg_2024 AS (
    SELECT 
        "Centre",
        AVG(monthly_rate) AS avg_rate_2024
    FROM att_2024
    GROUP BY "Centre"
),
-- Join and calculate the drop in percentage points
drops AS (
    SELECT 
        a23."Centre",
        a23.avg_rate_2023,
        a24.avg_rate_2024,
        (a23.avg_rate_2023 - a24.avg_rate_2024) AS drop_pp
    FROM avg_2023 a23
    JOIN avg_2024 a24 ON a23."Centre" = a24."Centre"
)
SELECT 
    "Centre"
FROM drops
WHERE drop_pp > 0
ORDER BY drop_pp DESC
LIMIT 1;
```
